content: Ifilisṭiniyyen ṭṭfen Ttabut n SIDI
Awař n Camwil yiweḍ ɣar marra Israil uca iffeɣ Israil ɣar umsagar ak-d Ifilisṭiniyyen i umenɣi akidsen. Nitni wtin iqiḍan nsen ɣar Abin-Haɛizir, uca Ifilisṭiniyyen wtin iqiḍan nsen ɣar Afiq.

Ifilisṭiniyyen sedden ixef nsen i umenɣi ak-d Israil uca umi imeyyeř umenɣi da d diha, ittwaɣelleb Israil zzat i wudem n Ifilisṭiniyyen uca nitni nɣin ɛřaḥař arebɛa-ařaf n yeryazen di řeṣfuf n řɛeskar nsen deg wazzay n umenɣi.

Umi iɛqeb řgens ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar, nnan imɣaren n Israil: “Mayemmi d aneɣ iwta SIDI ass-a zzat i wudem n Ifilisṭiniyyen? Ejj aneɣ ad neksi Ttabut n Řɛahd n SIDI zi Cilu, ad dd-tas di řwest nneɣ, ḥima ad aneɣ tfekk zeg ufus n řɛedyan nneɣ.”
Řgens issekk iryazen ɣar Cilu, iwyen-dd ssenni Ttabut n Řɛahd n SIDI n řɛeskarat wenni ittɣiman x ikiruben. Tuɣa dinni tnayen n iḥenjiren n Ɛali, Ḥufni d Finaḥas, ak-d Ttabut n Řɛahd n AREBBI.
Umi dd-tusa Ttabut n Řɛahd n SIDI ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar, imsar, aqa marra Israil isřiwřew s yijj n usřiwřew ijehden, ařami tarjiji temmurt.
Umi sřan Ifilisṭiniyyen i řḥess n usřiwřew, nnan: “Mana řḥess-a n usřiwřew ijehden di řmargeḥ n řɛeskar n Iɛibraniyyen?” Uca nitni fehmen, aqa Ttabut n SIDI tusa-dd di řmargeḥ n řɛeskar.
Ggʷeden Ifilisṭiniyyen aṭṭas, maɣar nitni nnan: “AREBBI yusa-dd ɣarsen ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar!” Uca nnan: “Ayyaw xaneɣ, maɣar aya ammu ɛemmarṣ war imsar!
Uct xaneɣ, man wen i d aneɣ ɣa ifekken zeg ufus n irebbiten ijehden? Ina d irebbiten i iwtin Imiṣriyyen s marra jjrayeḥ di řexřa!
Iřim tmeḥḍem u iřim d iryazen, kenniw Ifilisṭiniyyen, maḥend war tᵉttsexxarem i Iɛibraniyyen am mammec nitni ɣarwem sexxaren. Iřim d iryazen u menɣem!”

Uca ffɣen Ifilisṭiniyyen ɣar umenɣi u ittwaɣřeb Israil. Arewřen nitni, kuř ijj ɣar uqiḍun nnes. Tuɣa d ict n txessart d tameqqrant aṭṭas, ařami wḍan třatin-ařef n yeryazen zi Israil i dd-iffɣen ɣar umenɣi x iḍaren.
Ttabut n AREBBI tᵉttwaḥewwes u tnayen n iḥenjiren n Ɛali, Ḥufni d Finaḥas, mmuten.
Xenni yuzzeř ijjen zeg ayt n Binyamin zeg wazzay n umenɣi, yiweḍ ɣar Cilu deg wass nni simant nnes, s warruḍ icarreg uca acař tuɣa x uzeǧif nnes.

Řami yiweḍ netta, iqqim Ɛali x řkursi nnes ɣar tma n webrid, iqceɛ, minzi uř nnes tuɣa ittarjiji zi ssibbet n Ttabut n AREBBI. Umi dd-yusa weryaz nni maḥend ad t iḥaja di tendint, tesɣuy tendint marra.
Umi isřa Ɛali řḥess n usɣuyyi, inna: “Mana řḥess n řharaj-a n řɣaci nni?” Xenni iqeǧeq weryaz, yusa-dd, iḥaja t i Ɛali.
Tuɣa ɣar Ɛali tmenya u-tesɛin n iseggʷusa. Tiṭṭawin nnes dewřent arxunt, ařami war ittwiři ɛad.
Aryaz inna i Ɛali: “Necc usiɣ-dd zeg wazzay n umenɣi. Ass-a arewřeɣ zi řeṣfuf n řɛeskar.” Inna as Ɛali: “Min imsaren, a mmi?”

Areqqas yarra-dd xas, inna: “Israil yarweř zzat i wudem n Ifilisṭiniyyen u řgens igga ict n txessart tewɛar aṭṭas. Uřa d tnayen n iḥenjiren nnec, Ḥufni d Finaḥas, ttwanɣen u Ttabut n AREBBI tᵉttwaḥewwes.”

Umi netta yidar Ttabut n AREBBI, imsar, aqa Ɛali iwḍa ɣar ḍeffar zi řkursi zzat i tewwart. Netta yarreẓ zeg yiri uca iffeɣ as buḥbeř, maɣar aryaz tuɣa iwsar u idqeř. Netta tuɣa d řqaḍi x Israil arebɛin n iseggʷusa.

Tasřit nnes, tamɣart n mmis Finaḥas, tuɣa teksi s ddeyset, tuɣa ɛřayen ad dd-taruw. Umi nettat tesřa aqa Ttabut n AREBBI tᵉttwaḥewwes, u ɛemmis immut uřa d aryaz nnes, xenni tekmummec uca turuw-dd aḥenjir nnes, minzi tuɣa iṭṭef i-tt řewjeɛ nnes n tarut.
Umi dd-tiweḍ řweqt n řmewt nnes, nnant temɣarin tinni ɣares ibedden: “War tteggʷed ca, cem turwed-dd ijj n uḥenjir.” Maca nettat war xasent dd-tarri ca u uř nnes war tḥekkar.
Nettat tegga as i uḥenjir ‘Ikabud’, tenna: “Ittwakkes uɛuǧi zi Israil!”, minzi tᵉmmeksi Ttabut n AREBBI, uca uřa di ssibbet n řmewt n ɛemmis d weryaz nnes.
Nettat tenna: “Ittwakkes uɛuǧi zi Israil, maɣar tᵉmmeksi Ttabut n AREBBI.”

footnotes.text: Abin-Haɛizir- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘aẓru n uɛawen’ niɣ ‘aẓru n twiza’.
